module: GroundCover editor (grass, rocks, billboards spread over the terrain) of the world editor. "Ground Cover Editor" window in two columns: list of GroundCover objects on the left, details on the right (up to 8 types, object fields such as reflectScale/maxBillboardTiltAngle/shapesCastShadows, wind parameters windDirection/windGust*/windTurbulence*, validation panel). Changes go through setField/postApply and the editor's action history. Loads the editor_inspector extension.
notes: Hardcoded limits: 8 types per GroundCover (maxTypes) and 10922 billboards per cell (maxBillboardsPerCell).
The "Ground Cover Editor" edit mode has only one auxiliary shortcut: left click = Select.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every frame by the editor: draws the window (two-column table: object list and details; falls back to a simple display if the table cannot be opened).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the window (920x720), the groundCoverEditMode edit mode and the "Ground Cover Editor" menu entry (Terrain group).

onEditorObjectSelectionChanged.desc: Hook called when the editor's object selection changes: keeps the first selected GroundCover and invalidates the validation cache.

show.desc: Shows the GroundCover editor window and activates its edit mode. Usable from a script or another tool.
